page.layout: One printed page of running text in one main column; marginal line numbers and small reference notes at the left margin; a catchword-like signature "Ib" at the foot right; the facing page is show-through and dark, not transcribed.

main_text.p: [illegible, ~12 letters] pyrrho vicit, ipse obfæviriam a mi-[?]litibus lapidibus obrutus est. Valerius Car-[?]vequeanus [?] arcem ab eis recepit, sed præda-[?]toribus suis exclusit. Rutilius, Dictator in-[?]ter reliqua dilatus, castellum Fucinum * expu-[?]gnavit, & felicitate, quam gloria major Ro-[?]mam redit. Lavicanos †, novos tum hostes, [?]Tolicianum agrum vastantes, Q. Servilius Priscus Dictator, post rem male a filio gestam, [?]ceterum exuit, Lavicumque oppidum diripuit, & mille quingentos colonos eò misit. Volanti [?]Aequis deinde, per levem obsidionem ur-[?]bem & fines suos ingressi, sed cum coloniæ pro-[?]pter Tribunorum pervicaciam eò deduci non [?]potuit, Aequi urbem recuperarunt, & colo-[?]nos in eam deduxerunt. Domi de Tribunis [?]militum & plebe creandis inter Tribunos plebis [?]& Consules * decretum est, & tandem [?]Tribunorum militarium, consularis [?]potestas creandorum †, obtenta, sed Tri-[?]bunt plebis à petitione exclusi sunt. Roga-[?]tum, ut quicquid agrorum ubique esset bello [?]captum, victis plebi divideretur, Tribunata-[?]que promulgata est. Consules * que-[?]rerum de caede Politumiana moderatè exer-[?]cuerunt, & Ferviva † de incendendis urbe, &[?]Capitolio conjuravere, & pœnas [?]dedere. Post pœnam * cum inopia frugum[?]exorta est. Ibidem † Samnites in Urbem[?]Veturorum ab Hetruscis admissi incolæ trucida-[?]ti. Cæsar, ut ... Cimbrorum voluerunt Capitolio, Cimbrorum [?]vocem in servitutem redigere, & colonos ex [?]hac gravi eò deduxere.

page.notes: Page heavily damaged and faded; the left margin notes and the marginal numerals are largely illegible; the facing page is show-through and not transcribed. Greek and marginal-note content could not be read reliably, so many words are doubtful and marked [?]. The catchword at the foot right reads "Ib" (signature-like). Several lines are reconstructed from partial letters and are not reliable.
